EVT-0141.agent_script_text: Namaskar sir, hum aapko ek important reminder ke liye call kar rahe hain regarding aapka overdue payment. Aapka ₹1,98,502 ka invoice abhi 68 days overdue chal raha hai. Kripya is payment ko jaldi se jaldi clear karne ki kripa karein. Aapke cooperation ke liye dhanyawad.
EVT-0141.customer_response_text: Itna purana invoice hai toh main check karta hoon, yeh payment next week tak pakka clear ho jayegi.
